takes.text: Your agents work for hours. Decisions get buried in the text.
In Polaris, the work stays with agents. Decisions come to you.
One question, the context, clear options. Make the call.
Any goal, from a product to a language to a race, with strategies running at once.
Agents study what worked for goals like yours, and map out new strategy paths. Say yes, and they start the work.
You focus on goals and strategy.
Polaris. Open source, with your data on your Mac.
